topic: Range sums with point updates: why a Fenwick tree costs O(log n) for both.
goal: Explain the lowbit step that makes Fenwick update and query logarithmic.
grill: I want range sums with point updates in one structure.
I know prefix-sum arrays and I have seen the name Fenwick.
I think a Fenwick tree is a prefix-sum array with a different name.

facts.claim: A prefix-sum array answers a range sum in O(1) but an update costs O(n).
The lowbit of an index i is i & -i.
A Fenwick tree stores partial sums at lowbit steps, so an update and a query each touch O(log n) nodes.
facts.wrong: A Fenwick tree is a prefix-sum array, so an update still costs O(n).
